blurb: Guests rent boats to explore Kenai Fjords and Resurrection Bay on their own with provided gear and plotted routes. Boats are aluminum Hewescraft models designed for coastal Alaska conditions, equipped with safety gear and satellite communication. Fishing gear for salmon, halibut, and rockfish is included, and clients receive safety briefings and orientation before departure.
